jobs.occupation: Senior Engineer - AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling
jobs.description:
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

Employment Type: Permanent
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.

You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.
What You'll Do

• Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.

• Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.

• Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.

• Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.

• Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.

• Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.

• Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What We're Looking For

• Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.

• Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, LSP, or similar architectures.

• Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.

• Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.

• Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

• Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.

• Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

• Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.

• Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.

• Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.

• Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.

• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why Join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.

Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.

The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment.

About the Company

 

The R&D Center of a global leading ICT company, based in Amsterdam.

 

We are looking for a senior architect to drive the design and development of advanced OS-level system performance technologies and hardware-software-chip co-optimization for next-generation computing devices.

 

 

About the Role

 

The role focuses on system scheduling and performance optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, operating system, and chipset layers, balancing performance, power consumption, and thermal constraints. You will work across operating system, hardware, chipset, runtime, and application layers, driving technologies from architecture and research through implementation and deployment on end devices.

 

 

Responsibilities

 

 
• Design and develop hardware-software-chip co-optimization and integrated system scheduling technologies, including CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling, priority management, task grouping, core selection, frequency scaling, resource allocation, and performance/power/thermal-aware scheduling.
 
• Research and optimize application performance at the OS level, improving application interaction, responsiveness, animation smoothness, and overall system performance.
 
• Design and optimize high-performance core system modules and resolve critical system performance bottlenecks.
 
• Research and develop high-performance APIs, runtimes, application frameworks, and performance-oriented system technologies.
 
• Track advanced industry technologies and academic research and contribute to future technical roadmaps for system performance, scheduling, and hardware-software co-optimization.
 
• Drive technical solutions from architecture and research through implementation, validation, and deployment on end devices.

 

Required Skills

 

Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:

 
• OS or kernel performance optimization
 
• CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling and system resource management
 
• Hardware-software or chipset-level co-optimization
 
• Power- and thermal-aware scheduling and optimization
 
• Application or runtime performance optimization
 
• High-performance system, runtime, or framework design

In addition:

 
• Strong understanding of operating system architecture and system performance fundamentals.
 
• Hands-on experience identifying and resolving complex system performance bottlenecks.
 
• Proven ability to deliver measurable performance improvements in real-world systems or products.
 
• Strong problem-solving and engineering execution capabilities, with the ability to drive solutions from architecture and design through implementation.
 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across international research and engineering teams.

 

Preferred Skills

 
• Experience with Linux, Android, or other modern operating-system platforms.
 
• Experience with kernel scheduling, DVFS/frequency scaling, heterogeneous computing, graphics/GPU systems, memory systems, or chipset-level optimization.
 
• Experience working across hardware and software boundaries on complex computing platforms.
 
• Experience translating research or advanced technical concepts into production-level system technologies.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a PhD candidate to study neural organoids to predict neuroinvasive viruses We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to work as a doctoral candidate on the MSCA-DN DETECTIVE project. For rapid control of virus outbreaks, fast availability of antivirals is a major bottleneck. In DETECTIVE, innovative models will be used for setting up an antiviral testing pipeline without the need for animals models. This doctoral project will focus on developing patient-derived organotypic models to test and optimise broad-spectrum antiviral therapies. Organotypic models, such as human organoids, are miniaturised in vitro organ cultures that mimic the human tissue-specific context. In this project, gut organoid models co-cultured with immune cells will be used to determine antiviral efficacy of available broadly acting antiviral against a scala of outbreak viruses such as enteroviruses and West-Nile virus. Patient-specific responses to virus infections will be assessed with integrated -omics techniques, and patient-dependent responses to antiviral therapy will be used to develop personalized medicine regimens for the future. With this project we will set the stage for an innovative human antiviral testing pipeline for viral outbreaks. At the Amsterdam UMC, DETECTIVE is looking for a doctoral candidate (DC) to work on Work Package 1. As DC6, your objectives are: To establish patient-derived gut organoid mucosa models To test a panel of broadly acting antiviral compounds in patient-derived gut mucosa organoid models To identify virus and host factors determining treatment response by transcriptomics and proteomics You will be supervised by: Dr. Katja Wolthers Dr. Adithya Sridhar You will undertake international secondments within the DETECTIVE network, including: the Dutch Public Health Institute (Utrecht, Netherlands) the University of Tampere (Tampere, Finland) These secondments will provide exposure to both academic and industrial research

 Posted on Sep 22, 2026 
Deploy detailed models of coupled ocean / sea ice processes, probe their turbulent interactions, compare with observations, and design parameterizations for global climate models. 
Job description 
The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. 
This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica. 
Job requirements - PhD in oceanography, cryospheric science, climate science, or atmospheric science. - Experience with Large Eddy Simulations, turbulence research, and the Julia programming language is an advantage but not required. - Interest in the intersection of solid/fluid mechanics. - Ability to work independently. - Excellent command of written and spoken English. - Ability to start the position in January-March 2027 (with some flexibility).

Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? 
Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. 
Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control 
 How does cost control work within project organizations? 
Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? 
We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand. 
 Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing 
Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value).

Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Eindhoven, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders safely and on time. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. You check what you need for the day, get into the delivery van and use navigation to drive to your first customer. At each address, you select the correct order from the van and carry the grocery crates to the customer's front door. You provide friendly service and make sure the groceries are handed over carefully. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once everything is taken care of, you continue to the next customer. Your working day is a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. At the same time, you have plenty of independence while completing your route through Eindhoven and the surrounding area. After your final delivery, you return to the location, complete your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. When you start, you will recei

practical training. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how the job works before completing routes independently. What are the working hours? You do not have to work every Saturday. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of your working day. You will regularly lift and carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your route. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven You have a valid category B driving licence. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routes

independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

jobs.description:
Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Barendrecht. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. Your shift starts in Barendrecht, where you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to the first customer on your schedule. At each address, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully, provide friendly service and collect empty crates when necessary. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next stop. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Bleiswijk As a delivery driver, you are responsible for bringing Albert Heijn Online grocery orders from Bleiswijk to customers at home. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. Once you are ready, you get into the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and carry the grocery crates to the front door. You greet the customer, hand over the order and provide friendly service. When necessary, you also collect empty crates to take back with you. You then continue to the next address on your route. The position offers a combination of independence and customer contact. While you spend part of your working day driving, you are also regularly on your feet. Walking, lifting grocery crates and getting in and out of the van are all part of the job. Once all orders have been delivered, you return to the location in Bleiswijk and complete your shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous delivery or courier experience is not required. You will receive training when you start and can join an experienced colleague during your first working days. This allows you to learn the job before completing routes independently. What shifts are available? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I

need to work every Saturday? Not every Saturday. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement. Is this mainly a driving job? Driving is an important part of the position, but it is not the only task. You will regularly carry grocery crates, walk to customers' doors and get in and out of the delivery van. You therefore need to be comfortable with an active working day. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Bleiswijk You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Would you like to combine driving with an active job in Bleiswijk? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. We are a textile company founded in Seville over 20 years ago, with a presence across Spain, Europe, and Latin America through more than 100 company-owned stores and a strong online channel that connects us with customers worldwide. Our philosophy is based on offering original and sustainable fashion, fostering creativity, diverse talent, and responsible production.

Our portfolio includes brands with their own unique identity: Pampling, Wituka, Pájaro Flama, Nerry, Nostalgic Apparel, Agobio, Catharsis, BM Collective, Citees, Pampling&Co, among others. We also have our own screen-printing workshop, Print Guru (El Pulpo), which allows us to oversee every stage of production and ensure outstanding quality. In addition, we manage our logistics and distribution in-house, optimizing processes and providing an agile response across all our sales channels.

Who are we?

We are a diverse and dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and the drive to take on new challenges. We are looking for people with initiative, commitment, and a passion for design, fashion, and innovation. Our goal is to continue growing alongside a dedicated team while maintaining our focus on delivering high-quality products, competitive prices, and excellent customer service.

What are we looking for?

We are looking to hire Sales Assistants for our new Pampling&Co store located in Amsterdam city centre.

These are part-time positions of 20 and 30 hours with rotating morning and afternoon shifts, with an expected start date of September the 25th.

Previous customer service experience and a good level of English is required.

Main Responsibilities

- Advise and assist customers throughout their shopping experience.

- Answer customer inquiries, resolve issues, and process payments at the checkout.

- Support inventory management, stock control, orders, and warehouse operations.

- Maintain store visual standards in line with the brand's identity and values.

jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam
jobs.description:
Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21 and choose part-time or full-time hours. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to ride along with an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. A €150 net Bring a Friend bonus, subject to the applicable conditions. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online Home Shop Center at Beiraweg 6 in Amsterdam. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier

is not required. You will receive training when you start, and during your first working days you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the job in practice before driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I have to work on Saturdays? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Interested in working on the road in Amsterdam? Apply through Consolid for the position of Delivery Driver at Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Deploy detailed models of coupled ocean / sea ice processes, probe their turbulent interactions, compare with observations, and design parameterizations for global climate models. 
Job description 
The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. 
This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica. 
Job requirements - PhD in oceanography, cryospheric science, climate science, or atmospheric science. - Experience with Large Eddy Simulations, turbulence research, and the Julia programming language is an advantage but not required. - Interest in the intersection of solid/fluid mechanics. - Ability to work independently. - Excellent command of written and spoken English. - Ability to start the position in January-March 2027 (with some flexibility).

In electric vehicles, the propulsion system operates at high voltages. These can pose a danger to people who have to work on these vehicles. The employer is responsible for the safety of the staff. The EV workshop supervisor (EV-WV) is the one who is actually in charge of the work on e-vehicles.

Deploy detailed models of coupled ocean / sea ice processes, probe their turbulent interactions, compare with observations, and design parameterizations for global climate models. 
Job description 
The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. 
This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica.

jobs.occupation: PhD position in mechanisms of mixed neuropathologies in Alzheimer's disease
jobs.description:
Are you interested in studying the cellular pathways driving Alzheimer’s disease using human autopsy tissue and cell culture models? Come join our Neuropathology Research team and work together with experts in human brain tissue research and state-of-the- art disease modelling. Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common and currently incurable neurodegenerative disorder. It is characterized by the aggregation of tau and Aβ proteins in the brain. However, the neuropathological picture is often more complex than the aggregation of these two proteins alone. More than half of people with AD show additional aggregation of proteins associated with other neurodegenerative disorders, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and Parkinson’s disease. In this PhD project, you will investigate the mechanisms underlying the emergence of mixed neuropathologies in the brains of people with AD. You will work at the intersection of different neurodegenerative diseases and use human autopsy brain tissue, transcriptomics and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-based cell culture models. Your research will contribute to identifying disease mechanisms in AD, with potential relevance to other neurodegenerative disorders. During this four-year PhD project, you will work closely with molecular neuroscientists, neuropathology experts and bioinformaticians Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. You will investigate the biological mechanisms underlying mixed neuropathologies in Alzheimer’s disease. Your work combines human brain tissue research with advanced molecular and cellular models. You will: perform cutting-edge transcriptomic analyses; work with iPSC-based neural cultures and develop novel disease models; work with human autopsy brain tissue from people with Alzheimer’s disease, strengthening the translational impact of your research; study biological mechanisms in Alzheimer’s disease and

identify potential therapeutic targets. We are looking for a motivated researcher with an interest in neurodegenerative diseases and neuropathology. You have: a Master’s degree in neuroscience, biomedical sciences, biology or a related field; a demonstrable interest in neurodegenerative diseases and neuropathology; a strong background in wet-lab research; experience with cell culture is an advantage; strong analytical skills; experience with bioinformatics is an advantage; good oral and written communication skills in English. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months, with the intention to extend for a total of four years. The Guideline PhD contract applies to this vacancy. Classification in salary scale OIO: € 3.217 to € 4.077 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary here. Holiday hours: 194.4 per year for full time and a possibility to save additional hours. 100% reimbursement for public transport travel costs. If you travel by foot, bicycle, or car, a mileage allowance of €0.21 per km applies (up to a maximum of 40 km one way by car). Do you prefer walking or cycling? Take advantage of our good bike scheme. Pension accrual with BeFrank, a modern, comprehensible and fairly priced pension. Watch this video with more information about joining Amsterdam UMC Research BV. The Neuropathology Research team is part of the department of Pathology at Amsterdam UMC. The team consists of neuroscientists and neuropathologists working on research into neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer’s disease, frontotemporal dementia and ALS, as well as other brain disorders such as multiple sclerosis. Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role, for example by becoming a buddy for new drivers. An active job with plenty of variety and time on the road. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online location at Linie 11 in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Here, you collect the keys to your delivery van, check the route for your shift and get ready to head out. Once on the road, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. Your route can take you through Oosterhout and other places in the surrounding area, so every shift can look a little different. When you arrive at an address, you select the correct grocery order from the van and check it using a handheld scanner. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door and make sure the order is handed over correctly. Customer contact is an important part of the job. You greet customers in a friendly way, help with questions when necessary and process payments if required. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you continue your route. After completing the delivery, you get back behind the wheel and head to the next address. Although driving is a major part of the role, you will not spend your entire shift sitting down. You regularly get in and out of t

van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. This makes the job a good combination of driving, physical activity and customer service. Once you have completed your final delivery, you return to Linie 11. You finish your route, return the necessary equipment and leave the delivery van ready for the next shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. During your first working days, you will be trained by an experienced buddy. You will learn how to use the delivery van, handheld scanner and systems, as well as how to deliver orders and deal with different situations at the customer's door. Once you are familiar with the job, you can start driving your routes independently. Can I submit my own availability? Yes. You can let us know when you are available, and this will be taken into account when the schedule is created. You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. What does a typical shift involve? You start at Linie 11, collect your van and check your route. You then drive to the customers scheduled for your shift. At each stop, you scan and deliver the groceries, help the customer when needed and collect empty crates. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I develop within this role? Yes. Once you have gained experience, there are opportunities to take on additional responsibilities. For example, you may become a buddy and help train new delivery drivers during their first working days. Are you an Exterior Engineer, CAD Engineer or Product Design Engineer based in Portugal and ready to work on unique, high-end technical projects? Xelvin is looking for an engineer who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and contribute to the exterior design and engineering of luxury superyachts. In this role, you will translate design ideas and customer requirements into smart, manufacturable and high-quality technical solutions. You will work on exterior elements such as railings, sliding door systems, sunshade systems, masts, decorative elements, exterior panels and other visible parts of the yacht. This role combines technical engineering, design sensitivity and practical manufacturability. The exterior of a superyacht must not only function perfectly, but also look flawless. What you will do As an Exterior Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. You will work closely with project engineers, architects, production teams and external partners. Your responsibilities include: Creating and developing 3D models for exterior yacht components. Translating design concepts into practical and manufacturable solutions. Engineering exterior parts such as railings, doors, sunshade systems, panels, masts and decorative elements. Checking technical feasibility, quality, cost efficiency and production requirements. Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.

Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Superior Profissional, Licenciatura, Mestrado or comparable experience. A background in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Furniture/Interior Technology or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: industrial product design; shipbuilding or marine engineering; yacht interiors or yacht exteriors; metal structures, aluminium or stainless steel components; high-end custom engineering. Strong experience with 2D and 3D CAD software. Experience with SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, Inventor, Siemens NX, CATIA, Fusion 360 or similar software. Good understanding of manufacturability, materials and technical detailing. A strong eye for shape, finish and visual quality. Good English communication skills. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands. Dutch is not required. Willingness to learn Dutch over time is a plus. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading organization in the Dutch superyacht industry. The company designs, engineers and builds custom-made luxury yachts for international clients. Every project is unique and requires close collaboration between design, engineering, production, suppliers and specialist partners. The working environment is technical, international and quality-driven, with a strong focus on craftsmanship, innovation and tailor-made solutions.
